Class LinkedList.ListIterator

java.lang.Object
LinkedList.ListIterator
Enclosing class:
LinkedList<E extends Comparable<E>>
public class LinkedList.ListIterator extends Object

ListIterator.java -- an (inner) iterator class

Instance variables:

  • Node position - current position of iterator
  • Node previous - node prior to node at position

Methods (all are public)

  • Full constructor
  • restart
  • next
  • hasNext
  • peek
  • add
  • set
  • remove
  • note: equals and toString() are not implemented

Can throw a NoSuchElementException if trying to set or remove an element at a non-existent position

Can thrown an IllegalStateException if trying to peek at the next element in the list if none exists

Note: If any changes are made to a list, then the calling program should restart any iterators on that list

    • restart

    • next

      public E next()

    • hasNext

      public boolean hasNext()
      Returns true if there is a next element in the iterator
      Returns:
      true if the iterator is currently pointing to another node in the linked list

    • peek

      public E peek()
      Returns the next value to be returned by next() -- if there is one. Will throw an IllegalStateExpression if hasNext() is false.
      Returns:
      the element to be returned by next()

    • add

      public void add(E newData)
      add inserts a node before the node at location position. previous is placed at the new node. If hasNext() is false, then the node is added to the end of the list. If the list is empty, inserts node as the only node.

    • set

      public void set(E newData)
      Changes the object in the node at location position. Throws an IllegalStateException if position is not at a node,
      Parameters:
      newData - the object to replace the data section at the current node

    • remove

      public void remove()
      Removes the node at location position and moves position to the "next" node. Throws an IllegalStateException if the list is empty.
